scope: Reusable functions, annotation markers and ontology; no connected project or numeric design values
rules: Neutral is an individual AC conductor; no implicit connection to protective bonding.
GEC/EGC markers and fuel/exhaust legends have no electrical terminals.
Bonding-jumper endpoints require an explicit reviewed grounding detail and any intended domain-bridge evidence.
CT test-block ports are physical individual secondary conductors, not logical sensing signals; no shorting sequence is assumed.
Open/closed transition categories do not record contact position or establish synchronization/parallel approval.
Generator application class, operating mode, component condition and permit status are separate namespaces.
Fuel/start/auxiliary/transfer-path dependencies must be considered before any future availability or autonomy claim.
project_evidence_topics: source transition guards, interlocks and failure response
air district/CARB/fire/utility applicability and exact permits
